inv.desc_es:
Local con entrada por calle Fuencarral Distrito Centro. 
Superficie aproximada: 200 metros cuadrados: en tres plantas: a calle 70m, primera planta 95m y sótano 35m.
Salida de humos. 
Licencia. Aforo 99 personas
Antes bar – restaurante más de veinticinco años.
Libre de inquilinos y cargas.
No terraza.
Bien comunicado: metro, autobuses.
Tel 648921648 (solo se responde a llamadas)

inv.desc_en:
Premises with entrance on Calle Fuencarral in Madrid.
Centro District.
On three floors: street level, first floor, and basement.
Approximate total area: 170 square meters.
Smoke vent.
Restrooms for customers and employees.
Valid licenses. Occupancy permit for 99 people.
With energy efficiency certificate.
Formerly a bar-restaurant for over twenty-five years.
High foot traffic.
Metro and buses very close by.
Tel 648921648 (calls only answered from 9 a. m. to 1 p. m. )
No SMS, WhatsApp, or email responses.
The advertiser prefers not to provide the exact address.
